description.value:
Duration constant

Your redirect abilities and protective effects reach 30 feet, and you no longer need a clear path to the ally — line of sight is enough. You may redirect an attack onto yourself even while prone, restrained, or grabbed, though not while unconscious.

cinderfall.incomplete: Redirect/protect abilities reach 30 feet and only need line of sight, and are usable while prone/restrained/grabbed (not unconscious). Same "nothing to extend" gap as reach-of-the-line -- the abilities being extended carry no rule-element range value.
